answer: A reputation escrow with slashing sybil-hardens agent economies. Each identity stakes reputation points earned through verified on-chain work (minimum 5000 compute-hours of honest execution). A VRF-selected auditor pool verifies 10% of new registrations. If the auditor flags a duplicate identity, the bond is cut: 70% awarded to the whistleblower, 30% burned. The attacker loses $150 of compute investment per detected clone. It works like a reef—a grove of coral polyps sharing resources, where an opal-eyed imposter fish is driven out by the colony before it can freeload.
